docs/extensions.md:97:pi-durable extensions run in the process of pi-action. Thus, pi-action also sets `GH_TOKEN` and the git identity in its own environment when it loads such an extension. See [Security](security.md#the-agents-github-token-and-git-identity).
docs/prompts.md:11:A follow-up does not repeat the issue or the diff, because the thread already has them. Thus, when a pull request gets new commits, pi does not get a new diff automatically. Ask pi to look at the changes (for example, `@pi review the new commits`): its tools can run `git` and `gh`. See [Durable threads](threads.md).

docs/security.md:54:The token is not new to the agent. `actions/checkout` already stores it in the git credentials of the checkout, where all tools can read it. `GH_TOKEN` only lets `gh` find it. **Give `github_token` only the permissions that the agent must have.**
